what_it_is.prose: Toray Industries is a Japanese materials major and the world's largest producer of carbon fibre, marketed as TORAYCA, and of aerospace-grade thermoset prepreg. Its carbon-fibre and prepreg feed composite airframe structures across the global aerospace industry (for example under long-term agreements with Boeing). As an upstream materials supplier its products may reach composite structures used in Indian programmes indirectly, but there is no discrete, publicly documented India defence contract to cite. Recorded as an honest Tier C materials-supplier card.
